title: Egypt, *a destination special.*
subtitle: An Egypt episode for The Travel Diaries, recorded on location, with NOYA handling locations, permissions, hosting and movement.

blocks.text: The Travel Diaries already makes destination specials, from Queensland to Saudi Arabia. Egypt is a natural next one. NOYA proposes an episode recorded on location, with the guest of your choosing, while we handle locations, permissions, stays and movement on the ground.
Three settings few destinations can offer: Giza at first light, the Grand Egyptian Museum, and the Nile.
